title: StrikeMusic
features:
🚧 Pre-Launch Beta Version 🚧

StrikeChat is a universal social platform for Roblox currently in beta.

• Global chat, private rooms, and user profiles.
• Online users and real-time synchronization through a dedicated server.
• Modern interface optimized for both mobile and PC.

═══════════════════════
🎵 STRIKEMUSIC 🎵
═══════════════════════

• Search music instantly.
• Download songs directly to your library.
• Play your favorite tracks anytime.
• Personal music collection.
• Future room listening and shared music features.

═══════════════════════



⚠️ This is a beta release. More features and improvements will be added in future updates.

⭐ The points system is currently under development and will be available soon
